plain_description.what: Using cached verdicts from a generative arena (MATH and instruction-following, 3,000 verdicts, 8 models), the test asked two things. Is the judge-based certificate's confidence calibrated? Does a correction that widens its uncertainty point the right way and stay useful?
plain_description.why: The certificate attached to each cell is only trustworthy if its confidence statements can be checked against answer keys.
plain_description.information: A calibrated result would let the certificate be read at face value on these tasks. An undetermined one means there is not enough checkable data. Result: UNDETERMINED everywhere: the data falls about 50x short of what a readable calibration status needs. The correction points the expected way wherever instruction-following is included, but only borderline. On the stricter labels it is not identified. Its usefulness is 85% on MATH and only 33% on instruction-following, below the 60% bar.
